issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, the fields are declared in snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, number_of_guest_students, number_of_lecturers, number_of_tutors), but the constructor and all methods reference camelCase fields (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) that are not declared. This contradicts the problem statement/UML attribute names and causes the solution code to not compile.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution internally consistent and match the UML/problem statement by renaming the declared fields to camelCase: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors (and remove/replace the snake_case fields), or alternatively change all constructor/method references to use the snake_case names consistently (camelCase is the intended Java style here).
